items.title: AOA Dx Releases First-Ever Comprehensive Women’s Health Exit Analysis, Revealing $100B+ in Realized Value Over 25 Years
items.summary: AOA Dx unveiled Follow the Exits: Why Women’s Health Is a Smart Bet in Healthcare at the 2026 J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference, presenting the first comprehensive analysis of 25 years of realized exits in women’s health. The report documents more than $100B in disclosed exit value and demonstrates that women’s health is a scaled, durable healthcare sector with accelerating momentum across diagnostics, biopharma, and devices.

items.title: New Peer-Reviewed Publication Shows Multi-Omic Blood Test Achieves High Sensitivity For Early-Stage Ovarian Cancer Detection
items.summary: AOA Dx (AOA), a leader in blood-based diagnostics for early cancer detection, has published peer-reviewed clinical evidence showing high accuracy in detecting ovarian cancer in symptomatic women—a group where early diagnosis is essential yet often missed. This breakthrough highlights the potential to transform outcomes for women at risk.

items.title: New Peer-Reviewed Publication Shows Multi-Omic AI-Powered Blood Test Detects Ovarian Cancer with High Accuracy in Symptomatic Women
items.summary: AOA Dx (AOA), a company pioneering blood-based diagnostics for early cancer detection, has published peer-reviewed evidence demonstrating high accuracy in detecting ovarian cancer in symptomatic women, a population where early diagnosis is critical but often delayed.
